title: The Fear of Sitting // Sit In It

top_liked.author: @hopemokaya
top_liked.text:
Sit in it to me means:
1. Sit on the throne of Awareness. All you ever experience is the Self
2. When things get uncomfortable, sit with the emotions, they are your thoughts. You're only ever experiencing yourself, so sit and experience it and it will take a different form.

Sit…
